method: Two and a half seconds at 60 Hz of steady straight walking and running (one starting phase each). A near-floor episode follows the SAME skinned vertex while y <= 0.012 m for at least six samples; an episode still active at the end is marked truncated. Ground surface is at y=-0.002 m.
limitations: Near-floor is not known physical contact. Net movement is not a force measurement or the motion of an entire foot; toe roll, threshold and correlated vertices matter. No horizontal foot lock is implemented, and blends and short/reversed routes can still slide. Does not assess all poses, surfaces or naturalness.
